hero.subtitle: Protecting and helping to free human beings from vulnerability or distress through a holistic approach
hero.description: For overall health, human capital development and comprehensive well-being

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Contributing to improving the well-being of individuals suffering from various afflictions, by providing holistic support and care through integrated assistance (educational, health, psychosocial, sports, recreational, spiritual…). M2HC works to promote human capital development, capacity building and living together.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: Protecting and helping to free human beings from vulnerability through a holistic approach (mental, emotional, social, spiritual, psychological and physical), to restore fundamental balance and live in harmony.

values.title: Our Values
values.subtitle: The principles that guide our daily actions
values.dignityDesc: We place the value of each person at the center of our support.
values.holisticDesc: We consider human beings in all their dimensions: physical, mental, emotional and social.
values.empowermentDesc: We help everyone, especially women and young people, to become key actors of their own well-being.
values.empathyDesc: We offer caring, confidential and respectful support.
values.equityDesc: We work for fair and accessible well-being for all.
values.integrityDesc: We work with ethics, rigor and transparency.

about.title: About M2HC
about.subtitle: Marguerita Holistic Health Center - A holistic approach to your overall well-being

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To contribute to improving the well-being of individuals suffering from various afflictions by ensuring holistic support and care through integrated assistance (educational, health, psychosocial, sports, recreational, spiritual…). M2HC works to promote human capital development, capacity building, support for local initiatives, and living together.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To protect and help free human beings from states of vulnerability or distress through a holistic approach (mental, emotional, social, spiritual, psychological and physical), to restore fundamental balances and live in harmony with oneself, one's environment and society.

values.title: Our Values
values.subtitle: The principles that guide our actions

values.empowermentDesc: We help everyone, especially women and youth, to become key actors of their well-being.
values.empathyDesc: We offer caring, confidential and respectful support.
values.equityDesc: We work for fair and accessible well-being for all.
values.integrityDesc: We work with ethics, rigor and transparency.
values.preventionDesc: We prioritize awareness and promotion of sustainable well-being.
